description: This file defines types, validation functions, and a resolver for handling outbound media URLs in a LINE messaging context, supporting media type detection, URL validation, and URL resolution with options.

methods.name: validateLineMediaUrl
methods.description: Validates that a URL is well-formed, uses HTTPS, and is under 2000 characters.

methods.name: detectLineMediaKind
methods.description: Determines media kind ('image', 'video', 'audio') based on MIME type string.

methods.name: detectLineMediaKindFromUrl
methods.description: Infers media kind from URL pathname based on file extension.

methods.name: resolveLineOutboundMedia
methods.description: Resolves media URL with options, validating URL, inferring media kind, and returning a structured object.
